# requirements.txt states what this service needs and stays readable;
# this file states what it was last known to WORK with. Without it a rebuild
# months from now resolves `>=` afresh and can pull a release that breaks the
# build, or a vulnerable one, with nothing in the repository recording what the
# working set had been.
#
# Deploy applies this as pip CONSTRAINTS over requirements.txt, not as the
# install list — see the Dockerfile for why. To change a dependency, edit requirements.txt, install,
# run the tests, then regenerate:
#
#     python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
#     python -m pip freeze | sort > requirements.lock.txt
#
